sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In 1939, an astonishing new machine debuted at the World's Fair in New York City.
sentences.zh: 1939年，一台令人惊叹的新机器在纽约世界博览会上首次亮相。

sentences.en: It was called the Voter, short for Voice Operating Demonstrator.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“Voter”，是“语音操作演示器”（Voice Operating Demonstrator）的缩写。

sentences.en: It looked sort of like a futuristic church organ.
sentences.zh: 它看起来有点像未来派的教堂管风琴。

sentences.en: That's our own Delaney Hall.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的德莱尼·霍尔。

sentences.en: An operator, known as a Voterette, would sit at a curved wooden console.
sentences.zh: 操作员被称为“Voterette”，会坐在一个弧形的木制控制台前。

sentences.en: Behind her, there was a huge wall with an Art Deco image of a man's face
sentences.zh: 在她身后，有一面巨大的墙，上面画着一张装饰艺术风格的人脸，

sentences.en: with these spirals of curly hair.
sentences.zh: 还有卷曲的螺旋状头发。

sentences.en: His mouth was a giant speaker.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴是一个巨大的扬声器。

sentences.en: The Voterette would place her hands on two keyboards in front of her,
sentences.zh: Voterette会将双手放在面前的两个键盘上，

sentences.en: each with five or six white keys.
sentences.zh: 每个键盘有五到六个白键。

sentences.en: She'd use her feet to work two pedals down below.
sentences.zh: 她会用脚操作下方的两个踏板。

sentences.en: But instead of musical notes, the machine produced a voice.
sentences.zh: 但机器发出的不是音符，而是人声。

sentences.en: Now will you have him repeat that in a high voice.
sentences.zh: 现在请让他用高音重复一遍。

sentences.en: And now in his best face.
sentences.zh: 现在用他最好的表情。

sentences.en: This is from a demo recording of The Voter, produced in 1939, around the same time as the World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 这段录音来自1939年《Voter》的演示录音，大约是在世界博览会同期制作的。

sentences.en: Each of the keys on the keyboard controlled a particular frequency band.
sentences.zh: 键盘上的每个键都控制着特定的频段。

sentences.en: One foot pedal controlled pitch, and the other foot pedal controlled whether the sound would be muffled or crisp.
sentences.zh: 一个脚踏板控制音高，另一个控制声音是低沉还是清脆。

sentences.en: Operating this machine required incredible precision and skill.
sentences.zh: 操作这台机器需要极高的精确度和技巧。

sentences.en: For example, Voterettes would train for up to a year to make the voter actually talk like a person.
sentences.zh: 例如，Voterette需要接受长达一年的训练，才能让Voter真正像人一样说话。

sentences.en: Or sing like a person.
sentences.zh: 或者像人一样唱歌。

sentences.en: Suppose you sing a song for us, will you?
sentences.zh: 你愿意为我们唱首歌吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that's me.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是我。

sentences.en: Well, how about Au Lang Syne?
sentences.zh: 那么，唱首《友谊地久天长》怎么样？

sentences.en: Au Lang Syne?
sentences.zh: 《友谊地久天长》？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: She's a bird.
sentences.zh: 她真是一只小鸟。

sentences.en: And remember, this is all happening totally live.
sentences.zh: 记住，这一切都是完全现场直播的。

sentences.en: The Voterette is not triggering pre-recorded words.
sentences.zh: Voterette并不是在触发预先录制好的词汇。

sentences.en: Instead, the keys and pedals of the voter imitate the effects of the human vocal tract, producing the most basic building blocks of speech.
sentences.zh: 相反，Voter的按键和踏板模仿了人类声道的效果，产生了语音最基本的组成部分。

sentences.en: The Voterette is playing them in an intricate sequence, and she's actually synthesizing speech, real time.
sentences.zh: Voterette以复杂的顺序演奏它们，实际上是在实时合成语音。

sentences.en: The crowds at the World's Fair went crazy for this talking machine.
sentences.zh: 世界博览会上的观众对这台会说话的机器感到疯狂。

sentences.en: It created a sensation.
sentences.zh: 它引起了轰动。

sentences.en: This is John Paul.
sentences.zh: 这是约翰·保罗。

sentences.en: He's an engineer, inventor, and historian.
sentences.zh: 他是一位工程师、发明家和历史学家。

sentences.en: It was the first time there had ever been working speech synthesis, anywheres.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上第一次出现真正有效的语音合成技术。

sentences.en: People had no conception that you could even do it.
sentences.zh: 人们根本无法想象这竟然能做到。

sentences.en: Here's Voter's imitation of a cow.
sentences.zh: 这是Voter模仿牛的声音。

sentences.en: The Voter was invented by an engineer named Homer Dudley.
sentences.zh: Voter是由一位名叫霍默·达德利的工程师发明的。

sentences.en: And Homer Dudley's area of expertise was speech science.
sentences.zh: 而霍默·达德利的专业领域是语音科学。

sentences.en: Dudley worked at Bell Labs, a research facility that belonged to AT&T.
sentences.zh: 达德利在贝尔实验室工作，这是一个隶属于AT&T的研究机构。

sentences.en: And during the 1920s and 30s, Bell Labs was doing all kinds of research into the human voice.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代和30年代，贝尔实验室一直在进行各种关于人声的研究。

sentences.en: How to synthesize it electronically.
sentences.zh: 如何以电子方式合成它。

sentences.en: How to compress it so it could be sent across enormous distances quickly and cheaply.
sentences.zh: 如何压缩它，以便能快速、廉价地跨越巨大距离进行传输。

sentences.en: How to encode and disguise it.
sentences.zh: 如何编码和伪装它。

sentences.en: And all this research helped AT&T's basic goal, which was to improve the phone system in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所有这些研究都服务于AT&T的基本目标，即改善美国的电话系统。

sentences.en: The Voter was a novelty offshoot related to this research into speech.
sentences.zh: Voter是这项语音研究衍生出的一个新奇产物。

sentences.en: But it was closely connected to a number of Dudley's inventions at Bell Labs that still shape our world today.
sentences.zh: 但它与达德利在贝尔实验室的许多发明密切相关，这些发明至今仍在塑造我们的世界。

sentences.en: A lot of that basic research turned out to be things which have impacted our modern technology and world enormously.
sentences.zh: 很多基础研究最终都对我们的现代技术和世界产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Stuff that became critical to the development of digital media, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，那些对数字媒体发展至关重要的东西。

sentences.en: And on top of all of that, Dudley's inventions helped us win a war.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，达德利的这些发明还帮助我们赢得了战争。

sentences.en: Just a couple years after the voters debut at the World's Fair, Japan launched an early morning attack on Pearl Harbor in Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 就在Voter在世界博览会首次亮相几年后，日本对夏威夷珍珠港发动了清晨袭击。

sentences.en: It came as a profound shock to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这对美国来说是一个巨大的冲击。

sentences.en: And the next day, President Franklin Delano Roosevelt announced the country would be entering World War II.
sentences.zh: 第二天，富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福总统宣布美国将参加第二次世界大战。
zh_words: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福

sentences.en: With confidence in our armed forces, with the unbounding determination of our people, we will gain the inevitable triumph.
sentences.zh: 凭借对我们武装部队的信心，凭借我们人民无坚不摧的决心，我们将赢得不可避免的胜利。

sentences.en: So help us God.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我们。

sentences.en: World War II would be the most widespread war in history.
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战将是历史上规模最广泛的战争。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: would be fighting in Europe and the Pacific and parts of North Africa all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 将同时在欧洲、太平洋和北非部分地区作战。

sentences.en: And it was a huge challenge to coordinate troops across that much territory.
sentences.zh: 在如此广阔的领土上协调军队是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: It was obvious the only communication possible would be by radio.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，唯一可能的通讯方式就是无线电。

sentences.en: And that radio was, of course, insecure.
sentences.zh: 当然，无线电是不安全的。

sentences.en: The enemy is listening.
sentences.zh: 敌人正在监听。

sentences.en: In other words, there wasn't really anything besides radio that could stretch across the distances involved.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，除了无线电，真的没有什么东西能跨越这些距离。

sentences.en: But radio is easily intercepted.
sentences.zh: 但无线电很容易被拦截。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: The problem of encryption and secret messages of military importance became more and more serious.
sentences.zh: 加密和具有军事重要性的秘密信息问题变得越来越严重。

sentences.en: At the very start of the war, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 战争刚开始时，美国

sentences.en: military still relied on an old-school piece of technology for its sensitive conversations.
sentences.zh: 军方在进行敏感对话时仍然依赖一种老式的技术。

sentences.en: It was called the A3 Scrambler.
sentences.zh: 它被称为A3扰频器。

sentences.en: It worked by scrambling voice frequencies, swapping high frequencies for low and low frequencies for high, garbling the sound.
sentences.zh: 它的工作原理是打乱语音频率，将高频与低频互换，使声音变得模糊不清。

sentences.en: Here's an example of what it might have sounded like.
sentences.zh: 这是一个它听起来可能是什么样子的例子。

sentences.en: But it was easy to decode these scrambled conversations.
sentences.zh: 但这些被扰频的对话很容易被解码。

sentences.en: You know, the A3 was being compromised and it was not a secure system.
sentences.zh: 你知道，A3系统被破解了，它不是一个安全的系统。

sentences.en: That's Dave Tompkins, who's researched the history of various speech synthesizers and their connections to music.
sentences.zh: 那是戴夫·汤普金斯，他研究过各种语音合成器的历史及其与音乐的联系。

sentences.en: German intelligence was, they were essentially de-scrambling some of these conversations between FDR and Churchill in real time.
sentences.zh: 德国情报部门基本上是在实时解密罗斯福和丘吉尔之间的一些对话。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国

sentences.en: military knew the German codebreakers were listening in.
sentences.zh: 军方知道德国的密码破译员正在监听。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government gave Bell Labs the mission of creating an unbreakable speech encryptor.
sentences.zh: 政府给了贝尔实验室一项任务：制造一种无法破解的语音加密器。

sentences.en: And Bell Labs went to our old friend Homer Dudley, the guy who invented the talking machine of the World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 贝尔实验室找到了我们的老朋友霍默·达德利，就是那个发明了世界博览会会说话机器的人。

sentences.en: They said, Dudley, we need you to figure this out really faSt.
sentences.zh: 他们说，达德利，我们需要你尽快搞定这件事。

sentences.en: They were under tremendous wartime pressure to produce this thing quickly.
sentences.zh: 在战时压力下，他们必须迅速生产出这个东西。

sentences.en: I think the whole design took about a year.
sentences.zh: 我想整个设计大约花了一年时间。

sentences.en: Thankfully, Dudley had already been working on technology related to this problem for years.
sentences.zh: 值得庆幸的是，达德利多年来一直致力于与这个问题相关的技术研究。

sentences.en: It all went back to the voter and to another related invention of Dudley's called the vocoder.
sentences.zh: 这一切都要追溯到Voter和达德利的另一项相关发明，即声码器（Vocoder）。

sentences.en: Music nerds might know the term vocoder because it's the great-grandfather of the machine you hear in all kinds of pop music today.
sentences.zh: 音乐迷可能知道“声码器”这个词，因为它是你今天在各种流行音乐中听到的那种机器的鼻祖。

sentences.en: Vocoder was short for voice encoder.
sentences.zh: 声码器是“语音编码器”（voice encoder）的缩写。

sentences.en: And the machine could break down a human voice, separate it into its basic components,
sentences.zh: 这台机器可以将人声分解，将其分离成基本组成部分，

sentences.en: and then compress and transmit those components via shortwave channel.
sentences.zh: 然后通过短波频道压缩并传输这些部分。

sentences.en: It could transmit the minimal amount of signals required to reconstruct that message at the other end.
sentences.zh: 它能传输在另一端重建该信息所需的最少量信号。

sentences.en: This process was important, revolutionary actually, because it allowed the human voice to be digitized and compressed and sent across big distances.
sentences.zh: 这个过程非常重要，实际上是革命性的，因为它允许人声被数字化、压缩并跨越长距离传输。

sentences.en: But the vocoder didn't fully disguise the voice.
sentences.zh: 但声码器并没有完全伪装声音。

sentences.en: The transmission could still technically be pulled out of the air and decoded.
sentences.zh: 传输信号在技术上仍然可以从空中截获并解码。

sentences.en: So Dudley and his team had to add a layer of unbreakable encryption.
sentences.zh: 所以达德利和他的团队必须增加一层无法破解的加密。

sentences.en: And that's how the vocoder became just one small part of a much larger and more intricate apparatus.
sentences.zh: 这就是声码器如何成为一个更大、更复杂装置的一小部分。

sentences.en: A secure communications system that would allow allied military leaders in strategic locations around the world to talk in total secrecy.
sentences.zh: 一个安全的通讯系统，可以让世界各地战略要地的盟军军事领导人在绝对保密的情况下交谈。

sentences.en: It was called Project X, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“X计划”，又名

sentences.en: The Green Hornet, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: “绿大黄蜂”，又名

sentences.en: Sig Salley.
sentences.zh: 西格·萨利。

sentences.en: Which was short for nothing, really.
sentences.zh: 这名字其实没什么缩写含义。

sentences.en: It was meant to be confusing.
sentences.zh: 它本意就是为了让人困惑。

sentences.en: Each Sig Salley machine was enormous, weighing more than 50 tons.
sentences.zh: 每一台Sig Salley机器都非常巨大，重达50多吨。

sentences.en: It was a pretty complicated behemoth of a device.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当复杂的庞然大物。

sentences.en: It wasn't even a device, it was a room in itself.
sentences.zh: 它甚至算不上是一个设备，它本身就是一个房间。

sentences.en: It occupied about 2,000 square feet and was made up of 40 racks of equipment.
sentences.zh: 它占地约2000平方英尺，由40个设备架组成。

sentences.en: It needed air conditioning because a lot of the electronics was so delicately balanced
sentences.zh: 它需要空调，因为很多电子元件的平衡非常微妙，

sentences.en: that if it got too hot or too cold, it would not work properly.
sentences.zh: 如果太热或太冷，它就无法正常工作。

sentences.en: In fact, the device was full of so many finely calibrated tubes and gadgets
sentences.zh: 事实上，这个设备里装满了如此多精密校准的电子管和装置，

sentences.en: that the military created a whole division of engineers whose sole job was to maintain the machines.
sentences.zh: 以至于军方专门成立了一个工程师部门，其唯一的工作就是维护这些机器。

sentences.en: The 805th Signal Service Company.
sentences.zh: 第805信号服务连。

sentences.en: We're pretty much in charge of the installation and operation of the system.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上负责系统的安装和操作。

sentences.en: That's Don Mell.
sentences.zh: 那是唐·梅尔。

sentences.en: Before he enlisted, he was an amateur radio operator from Omaha.
sentences.zh: 入伍前，他是奥马哈的一名业余无线电操作员。

sentences.en: And he was one of the engineers assigned to work on Sig Salley.
sentences.zh: 他是被指派负责Sig Salley工作的工程师之一。

sentences.en: He reported for duty in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 他在华盛顿特区报到，

sentences.en: and spent his first two weeks in an intensive class.
sentences.zh: 并花了两周时间参加强化课程。

sentences.en: Where we learned all the technical details and the operation,
sentences.zh: 我们在那里学习了所有的技术细节和操作，

sentences.en: and that was pretty much on-the-job training.
sentences.zh: 那基本上就是边做边学。

sentences.en: The first Sig Salley terminal was installed in the basement of the Pentagon,
sentences.zh: 第一台Sig Salley终端安装在五角大楼的地下室里，

sentences.en: and it was connected to several conference rooms upstairs.
sentences.zh: 并连接到楼上的几个会议室。

sentences.en: Elegantly furnished.
sentences.zh: 装修非常考究。

sentences.en: There was wine-colored, thick, thick carpeting on the floor.
sentences.zh: 地板上铺着厚厚的酒红色地毯。

sentences.en: They were beautiful rooMs.
sentences.zh: 那些房间非常漂亮。

sentences.en: This is Lieutenant Colonel Dorothy L.
sentences.zh: 这是多萝西·L·中校，

sentences.en: Madsen.
sentences.zh: 马德森。

sentences.en: But my nickname is Meg, M-E-G.
sentences.zh: 但我的昵称是梅格（Meg）。

sentences.en: I was in charge of the Global Encrypted Conference Center.
sentences.zh: 我负责全球加密会议中心。

sentences.en: The conference center is where D.C.-based military leaders would meet to speak over the Sig Salley system.
sentences.zh: 会议中心是华盛顿的军事领导人通过Sig Salley系统进行交谈的地方。

sentences.en: So while Don Mell was down in the basement running the machine,
sentences.zh: 所以当唐·梅尔在地下室运行机器时，

sentences.en: Meg was upstairs, coordinating conference calls with the military brass.
sentences.zh: 梅格就在楼上协调与军方高层的电话会议。

sentences.en: She hosted everyone from President Harry Truman to General George Marshall.
sentences.zh: 她接待过从哈里·杜鲁门总统到乔治·马歇尔将军的每一个人。

sentences.en: She sat in on their meetings and transcribed the conversations they had.
sentences.zh: 她参加了他们的会议并记录了他们的谈话。

sentences.en: Any of the men who had the responsibility for the conduct of the war and had to make their phone calls
sentences.zh: 任何负责指挥战争并需要打电话的人，

sentences.en: came to my conference center to do that.
sentences.zh: 都会来到我的会议中心进行通话。

sentences.en: Communications is the most important thing, and you have to do it with safety and security
sentences.zh: 通讯是最重要的事情，你必须确保它的安全和保密，

sentences.en: that nobody else is tuned in on it.
sentences.zh: 不能让其他人监听。

sentences.en: The Sig Salley terminal in the Pentagon was connected to a network of close to a dozen other Sig Salley terminals around the world.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼的Sig Salley终端连接着全球近一打其他的Sig Salley终端网络。

sentences.en: These were located in the most strategically important places,
sentences.zh: 这些终端位于最具战略意义的地方，

sentences.en: where politicians and military leaders would need to be talking with each other on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 政治家和军事领导人需要经常在这些地方进行沟通。

sentences.en: Algiers and London and Paris eventually, and Hawaii and Guam and Australia.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及尔、伦敦、巴黎，后来还有夏威夷、关岛和澳大利亚。

sentences.en: There was even a Sig Salley terminal based on a roving ship in the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一台Sig Salley终端安装在太平洋的一艘巡航舰上。

sentences.en: And one in beautiful, strategically important, Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 还有一台在美丽且具有战略意义的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市。

sentences.en: This network allowed leaders in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这个网络允许华盛顿特区的领导人

sentences.en: to talk securely with any location that had a terminal.
sentences.zh: 与任何拥有终端的地点进行安全通话。

sentences.en: All they needed was a shortwave radio connection.
sentences.zh: 他们所需要的只是一个短波无线电连接。

sentences.en: And one other key component.
sentences.zh: 以及另一个关键组件。

sentences.en: A pair of vinyl phonograph records of totally random noise.
sentences.zh: 一对包含完全随机噪音的黑胶唱片。

sentences.en: This is where the encryption part comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是加密技术发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: Because for every conference that happened over Sig Salley,
sentences.zh: 因为对于每一次通过“西格·萨利”进行的会议，

sentences.en: both the sending and receiving terminals had to have identical records,
sentences.zh: 发送端和接收端的终端都必须拥有完全相同的记录，

sentences.en: which played the sound of noise.
sentences.zh: 这些记录播放的是一种噪音。

sentences.en: The noise would combine with the voice components as they were transmitted via shortwave radio,
sentences.zh: 当这些噪音通过短波无线电传输时，会与语音成分混合，

sentences.en: making it impossible for eavesdroppers to decrypt.
sentences.zh: 使得窃听者无法解密。

sentences.en: On the receiving end, the random noise would be extracted and the voice restored.
sentences.zh: 在接收端，随机噪音会被提取出来，从而还原出语音。

sentences.en: In cryptography, these records are what's known as a one-time key.
sentences.zh: 在密码学中，这些记录被称为“一次性密钥”。

sentences.en: So here's how they worked.
sentences.zh: 下面是它们的工作原理。

sentences.en: Random noise would be generated,
sentences.zh: 首先生成随机噪音，

sentences.en: and then pressed on a gold master.
sentences.zh: 然后将其压制成一张黄金母盘。

sentences.en: Normally a phonograph record, you would reproduce thousands of them from a single master.
sentences.zh: 通常是唱片，你可以用一张母盘复制出成千上万张唱片。

sentences.en: In this case, they made exactly two records.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，他们只制作了正好两张唱片。

sentences.en: The identical and now totally unique records would be assigned a matching codename.
sentences.zh: 这两张完全相同且独一无二的唱片会被分配一个匹配的代号。

sentences.en: And these codenames were awesome.
sentences.zh: 而且这些代号非常酷。

sentences.en: Like Red Strawberry, or Wild Dog, or Circus Clown.
sentences.zh: 比如“红草莓”、“野狗”或“马戏团小丑”。

sentences.en: So let's say President Harry Truman in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 假设华盛顿特区的哈里·杜鲁门总统

sentences.en: wants to talk with Prime Minister Winston Churchill in London.
sentences.zh: 想要与伦敦的温斯顿·丘吉尔首相通话。

sentences.en: Truman keeps one of the two records in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 杜鲁门在华盛顿特区保留其中一张唱片。

sentences.en: The second one would be sent to the station at the other side of the ocean,
sentences.zh: 第二张会被送到大洋彼岸的电台，

sentences.en: and then placed on this special precision turntable.
sentences.zh: 然后放置在这个特殊的精密转盘上。

sentences.en: That was a part of the Sig Salley terminal.
sentences.zh: 那是“西格·萨利”终端的一部分。

sentences.en: At the scheduled time for the conference, Sig Salley engineers in D.C.
sentences.zh: 在预定的会议时间，华盛顿特区和伦敦的“西格·萨利”工程师

sentences.en: and London would tune in to WWV.
sentences.zh: 会调频到 WWV。

sentences.en: Which is the international time control station, so that we could synchronize our control clocks exactly.
sentences.zh: 这是国际时间控制台，这样我们就能精确同步我们的控制时钟。

sentences.en: Then they'd get their identical records spinning on their respective turntables at exactly the same moment.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们会在同一时刻让各自转盘上完全相同的唱片开始旋转。

sentences.en: Once the records were synced, Truman would speak into a handset in Meg's conference room at the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 一旦唱片同步，杜鲁门就会对着五角大楼梅格会议室里的听筒说话。

sentences.en: This is the President, Mr. Prime Minister.
sentences.zh: “我是总统，首相先生。”

sentences.en: This is a reenactment of Truman and Churchill greeting each other when they talked via Sig Salley to discuss a German surrender proposal in 1945.
sentences.zh: 这是对1945年杜鲁门和丘吉尔通过“西格·萨利”讨论德国投降提议时互相问候的重现。

sentences.en: The signal would go down into the basement where Don was running the Sig Salley terminal.
sentences.zh: 信号会传送到地下室，唐正在那里操作“西格·萨利”终端。

sentences.en: The terminal would digitize Truman's voice, mix it with random noise from the record,
sentences.zh: 终端会将杜鲁门的语音数字化，与唱片中的随机噪音混合，

sentences.en: and then transmit that signal across the ocean via shortwave radio.
sentences.zh: 然后通过短波无线电将该信号传输到大洋彼岸。

sentences.en: On the other end, the Sig Salley terminal in London would reverse the process.
sentences.zh: 在另一端，伦敦的“西格·萨利”终端会反向执行这一过程。

sentences.en: It would remove the noise, reconstruct the voice, and feed it through Churchill's handset.
sentences.zh: 它会去除噪音，重构语音，并将其传送到丘吉尔的听筒中。

sentences.en: After so much processing and such a long distance, the voice didn't sound very good.
sentences.zh: 经过如此多的处理和如此长的距离，语音听起来效果并不好。

sentences.en: Like gibberish orated from the bottom of a barrel.
sentences.zh: 就像从木桶底部传出的胡言乱语。

sentences.en: But it was intelligible.
sentences.zh: 但它是可以听懂的。

sentences.en: You had to kind of train your ear a bit.
sentences.zh: 你得稍微训练一下你的耳朵。

sentences.en: Anyway, then Churchill would reply,
sentences.zh: 总之，丘吉尔会回答说，

sentences.en: How glad I am to hear your voice.
sentences.zh: “听到你的声音我真高兴。”

sentences.en: And the whole process would be reversed.
sentences.zh: 整个过程会反向进行。

sentences.en: In this way, Truman and Churchill could have a completely secure, real-time conversation,
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，杜鲁门和丘吉尔可以进行完全安全、实时的对话，

sentences.en: planning, plotting, and strategizing about the war.
sentences.zh: 策划、密谋并制定战争策略。

sentences.en: When the conversation ended, the two records, which, remember,
sentences.zh: 当对话结束时，这两张唱片——记住，

sentences.en: contained the top-secret random noise key, would be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 里面包含了绝密的随机噪音密钥——会被销毁。

sentences.en: That's because if anyone was recording this communication as it traveled over the ocean,
sentences.zh: 这是因为如果有人在信号跨越大洋时对其进行录音，

sentences.en: the random noise record would be the key to decrypting it.
sentences.zh: 这张随机噪音唱片就是解密它的关键。

sentences.en: It would allow them to subtract the noise in the same way the Sig Salley engineers did at each end of the transmission.
sentences.zh: 它允许他们像“西格·萨利”工程师在传输两端所做的那样，减去噪音。

sentences.en: So the records were the most classified and sensitive component of Sig Salley.
sentences.zh: 所以这些唱片是“西格·萨利”中最机密、最敏感的组件。

sentences.en: By the end of World War II, there had been a total of about 3,000 top-secret strategic conferences.
sentences.zh: 到第二次世界大战结束时，总共进行了约3000次绝密战略会议。

sentences.en: In other words, at least 6,000 vinyl records that were pressed, delivered, used,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，至少有6000张黑胶唱片被压制、运送、使用，

sentences.en: and then destroyed at the end of the call.
sentences.zh: 并在通话结束后被销毁。

sentences.en: Compared to today, it would be rudimentary-type technology.
sentences.zh: 与今天相比，这属于原始技术。

sentences.en: But for that time, it was, where in advance, nobody had even thought of voice communications in terms of being digitized.
sentences.zh: 但在那个时代，它是领先的，当时没人想到语音通信可以数字化。

sentences.en: And because of Sig Salley, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正因为有了“西格·萨利”，美国

sentences.en: was able to communicate with the Allies in real time and by voice.
sentences.zh: 才能够与盟军进行实时的语音通信。

sentences.en: So if people were listening in to that signal, if Germans were listening in, what would they hear?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果有人在监听那个信号，如果德国人在监听，他们会听到什么？

sentences.en: Nothing but random noise.
sentences.zh: 除了随机噪音，什么也没有。

sentences.en: Just total white noise.
sentences.zh: 完全是白噪音。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, it might have been so unintelligible that they didn't even realize they were listening to anything at all.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它可能听起来太模糊，以至于他们甚至没意识到自己在监听任何东西。

sentences.en: They never knew of the existence of the system,
sentences.zh: 他们从未知道这个系统的存在，

sentences.en: and they never had any inkling that it was an encrypted speech.
sentences.zh: 也从未察觉到这是加密语音。

sentences.en: In fact, that's why Sig Salley was nicknamed the Green Hornet after the popular 1940s radio show.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这就是“西格·萨利”被称为“青蜂侠”的原因，源自20世纪40年代流行的广播节目。

sentences.en: The Green Hornet.
sentences.zh: “青蜂侠”。

sentences.en: Because an intercepted Sig Salley transmission sounded like nothing more than a Hornet's buzz.
sentences.zh: 因为截获的“西格·萨利”传输听起来就像大黄蜂的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: Sig Salley was involved in pretty much every major military operation after 1942.
sentences.zh: “西格·萨利”参与了1942年后的几乎所有重大军事行动。

sentences.en: It was even critical in the planning of the Manhattan Project and the dropping of the atomic bombs over Japan.
sentences.zh: 它甚至在曼哈顿计划的规划和向日本投掷原子弹的过程中起到了关键作用。

sentences.en: Don Mell was the engineer decrypting and listening in on those Sig Salley conversations,
sentences.zh: 唐·梅尔是负责解密并监听这些“西格·萨利”对话的工程师，

sentences.en: even though he didn't know at the time the meaning of the code words they were using.
sentences.zh: 尽管他当时并不知道他们所使用的代号的含义。

sentences.en: And I would see these sheets coming over and the title was Manhattan Project.
sentences.zh: “我会看到这些文件传过来，标题是‘曼哈顿计划’。

sentences.en: Well, I, of course, didn't know what the Manhattan Project was.
sentences.zh: 当然，我不知道曼哈顿计划是什么。”

sentences.en: Don didn't reflect much on the grave implications of those meetings he overheard.
sentences.zh: 唐并没有过多思考他所窃听的那些会议的严重影响。

sentences.en: He was an engineer, doing his best to keep the equipment running.
sentences.zh: 他是一名工程师，尽其所能保持设备运行。

sentences.en: But you didn't pay that much attention to everything that was said.
sentences.zh: “但你不会太注意所说的每一件事。

sentences.en: You're more concerned with the transmission.
sentences.zh: 你更关心的是传输本身。”

sentences.en: But he knows it would have been hard for the Allies to win the war without Sig Salley.
sentences.zh: 但他知道，如果没有“西格·萨利”，盟军很难赢得这场战争。

sentences.en: It's hard to say what we would do if we didn't have it.
sentences.zh: “很难说如果我们没有它会怎么样。”

sentences.en: Even if that victory sometimes came at a brutal price.
sentences.zh: 即使这种胜利有时付出了残酷的代价。

sentences.en: At the end of the war, the Sig Salley terminals were dumped in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，“西格·萨利”终端被扔进了大海。

sentences.en: Almost every encryption device was intentionally destroyed when the war was over for security purposes
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的加密设备在战争结束后都被故意销毁，以确保安全，

sentences.en: to the extent of destroying the plans.
sentences.zh: 甚至连设计图纸都被销毁了。

sentences.en: But not before the military developed successors that were smaller and simpler and easier to set up.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，军方开发了更小、更简单、更容易安装的后续产品。

sentences.en: These new devices still worked on the same principles of encryption as Sig Salley.
sentences.zh: 这些新设备仍然遵循与“西格·萨利”相同的加密原理。

sentences.en: And they were used for secure communications during the Cold War, the Korean War,
sentences.zh: 它们被用于冷战、朝鲜战争期间的安全通信，

sentences.en: and to negotiate the Cuban Missile Crisis.
sentences.zh: 以及古巴导弹危机的谈判。

sentences.en: A lot of the information related to Sig Salley wasn't declassified until the mid-1970s,
sentences.zh: 许多与“西格·萨利”相关的信息直到20世纪70年代中期才解密，

sentences.en: when AT&T sued the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时美国电话电报公司（AT&T）根据《信息自由法》起诉了

sentences.en: military under the Freedom of Information Act.
sentences.zh: 美国军方。

sentences.en: Once it was public, technology that originated with Sig Salley went on to entirely new realMs.
sentences.zh: 一旦公开，源自“西格·萨利”的技术就进入了全新的领域。

sentences.en: The vocoder, for instance, went on to have a whole new life in music.
sentences.zh: 例如，声码器在音乐领域获得了全新的生命。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, electronic musicians like Kraftwerk began using a smaller version of the machine
sentences.zh: 20世纪70年代，像发电站乐队（Kraftwerk）这样的电子音乐人开始使用该机器的缩小版

sentences.en: to create weird, robotic vocal effects.
sentences.zh: 来创造怪异的机器人人声效果。

sentences.en: From Germany, the vocoder spread to the Bronx in Brooklyn,
sentences.zh: 从德国，声码器传到了布朗克斯和布鲁克林，

sentences.en: where hip-hop and electro-funk groups started playing around with it.
sentences.zh: 嘻哈和电音放克团体开始尝试使用它。

sentences.en: Now you hear it all over the place.
sentences.zh: 现在你到处都能听到它。

sentences.en: But the vocoder's reach actually goes way beyond the robot voice.
sentences.zh: 但声码器的影响力实际上远不止机器人声音。

sentences.en: You're also using vocoder every time you use your mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 你每次使用手机时也在使用声码器。

sentences.en: But of course, in a much, much reduced size.
sentences.zh: 当然，尺寸要小得多。

sentences.en: The giant, clunky machine of the past now occupies the space of a tiny chip,
sentences.zh: 过去巨大笨重的机器现在只占据一个小芯片的空间，

sentences.en: which compresses speech and allows hundreds of conversations
sentences.zh: 它压缩语音并允许数百次对话

sentences.en: to pass through a single cell phone tower.
sentences.zh: 通过同一个手机信号塔。

sentences.en: And a lot of the technology used to transmit media on the internet
sentences.zh: 而且互联网上用于传输媒体的许多技术

sentences.en: can be traced back to Dudley, too.
sentences.zh: 也可以追溯到达德利。

sentences.en: That includes MP3 music.
sentences.zh: 这包括MP3音乐。

sentences.en: That includes video compression.
sentences.zh: 这包括视频压缩。

sentences.en: So give thanks to Homer Dudley every time you watch something on the internet.
sentences.zh: 所以每次你在互联网上观看东西时，都要感谢霍默·达德利。

sentences.en: All those millions of viral videos would take up too much space
sentences.zh: 如果不能压缩，那数以百万计的病毒式视频

sentences.en: if they couldn't be compressed.
sentences.zh: 会占用太多空间。

sentences.en: Dudley bit me.
sentences.zh: “达德利咬了我。”

sentences.en: Oh my god, it's full on.
sentences.zh: “天哪，太震撼了。”

sentences.en: Double rainbow all the way across the sky.
sentences.zh: “双重彩虹横跨整个天空。”

sentences.en: Everything in our modern digital world of media
sentences.zh: 我们现代数字媒体世界中的一切

sentences.en: can be traced back to Dudley's vocoder and to Sig Solly.
sentences.zh: 都可以追溯到达德利的声码器和“西格·萨利”。

sentences.en: In the end, the vocoder kind of came full circle.
sentences.zh: 最终，声码器算是一个轮回。

sentences.en: It started its public life as a silly novelty gag,
sentences.zh: 它作为一种愚蠢的新奇玩意儿开始其公众生涯，

sentences.en: making animal noises for crowds at the 1939 World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 在1939年世界博览会上为人群制造动物叫声。

sentences.en: And here's a pig.
sentences.zh: “这是一头猪。”

sentences.en: Then, like Don Mel and Meg Mattson,
sentences.zh: 然后，像唐·梅尔和梅格·马特森一样，

sentences.en: the vocoder enlisted.
sentences.zh: 声码器应征入伍了。

sentences.en: It did its service.
sentences.zh: 它履行了自己的职责。

sentences.en: It helped the Allies win the biggest war the world had ever known.
sentences.zh: 它帮助盟军赢得了世界历史上最大的战争。

sentences.en: And now, it's back to civilian life.
sentences.zh: 现在，它又回到了平民生活。

sentences.en: Making silly noises once again.
sentences.zh: 再次制造愚蠢的声音。

sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由德莱尼·霍尔制作，

sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯特德、谢里夫·优素福，以及我，罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Dave Tompkins,
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢戴夫·汤普金斯，

sentences.zh: 《如何毁掉一个好海滩》的作者，

sentences.zh: 该书讲述了从二战到嘻哈音乐的声码器历史。

sentences.zh: 他的书启发了这一集，

sentences.zh: 并深入探讨了声码器如何

sentences.zh: 从军事领域进入流行音乐的历史。

sentences.en: Thanks also to Ben and Yvette Sinek of Nucleus,
sentences.zh: 还要感谢Nucleus的本和伊薇特·西内克，

sentences.en: David Kahn, author of The Code Breakers,
sentences.zh: 《破译者》的作者大卫·卡恩，

sentences.en: and Stephen Jackson.
sentences.zh: 以及斯蒂芬·杰克逊。

sentences.en: And finally, thanks to Pat Massidi-Miller,
sentences.zh: 最后，感谢帕特·马西迪-米勒，

sentences.zh: 他为哈里·杜鲁门总统配音。

sentences.en: Winston Churchill was played by our new staffer,
sentences.zh: 温斯顿·丘吉尔由我们的新员工配音，

sentences.en: man of a thousand voices, Sharif Youssef.
sentences.zh: 千面人谢里夫·优素福。

sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSign的办公室制作，

sentences.en: the East Bay's premier architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是东湾首屈一指的建筑和室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于加利福尼亚州美丽的奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞我们的节目。

sentences.en: Follow us all on Twitter and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 在Twitter和Instagram上关注我们。

sentences.en: But the best way to explore the 99% invisible activity
sentences.zh: 但探索塑造我们世界设计的

sentences.en: that shapes the design of our world
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》活动的最好方式，

sentences.en: is to become good friends with our website.
sentences.zh: 是与我们的网站成为好朋友。

sentences.en: It's 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99pi.org。

sentences.en: What's the matter?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: That sounds great, T-Pain.
sentences.zh: 听起来很棒，T-Pain。

sentences.en: Let's get a little less vocoder on.
sentences.zh: 我们把声码器效果调小一点吧。

sentences.en: You want less vocoder?
sentences.zh: 你想要少一点声码器效果？

sentences.en: Yeah, way too much like a robot.
sentences.zh: 对，听起来太像机器人了。

sentences.en: Okay, I'll ask.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我去问问。

sentences.en: Hey, vocoder,
sentences.zh: 嘿，声码器，

sentences.en: T-Pain wants a little less effect on this.
